title: The Weekly Closeout: Mud Jeans files for bankruptcy and is the K-shaped economy over?
summary: The circular denim brand was saddled with debt. Meanwhile, many analysts are turning against the letter K in describing the U.S. economy.

title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
summary: Nvidia has a plan to make sure its GPUs won't lose value. It wants to convince a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.

title: FTC Strikes Deals to Ignore Unlawful Credit Discrimination
summary: The agency signed agreements to not enforce parts of three federal court orders against auto dealers accused of discrimination—and didn’t notify judges or at least one of its coplaintiffs.

title: 5th Circuit strikes down No Surprises billing benchmark in win for providers
summary: The court ruled Tuesday that insurers can’t include ghost rates or exclude bonus payments in calculating a metric used to determine reimbursement for out-of-network bills. That’s set to further inflate payouts to providers.

title: March of Dimes: Maternity care deserts persist, Medicaid cuts threaten to curb access further
summary: A number of factors contribute to access, including the availability of OB clinicians, insurance coverage and access to birthing facilities.

title: Building a practical path to post-quantum cryptography
